title: Prepositions of Place: In, On, Under, Next to
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Has aprendido a ubicar objetos y personas en tu oficina usando preposiciones de lugar básicas.

parts.visual: 'In' (dentro de): The file is in the cabinet. 'On' (sobre una superficie): The pen is on the desk.
parts.audio: In means inside: The file is in the cabinet. On means on a surface: The pen is on the desk.

parts.visual: 'Under' (debajo de): The trash bin is under the desk. 'Next to' (al lado de): The printer is next to the computer.
parts.audio: Under means below: The trash bin is under the desk. Next to means beside: The printer is next to the computer.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la preposición de lugar correcta según el contexto.

questions.question: The pen is ____ the desk (sobre la superficie).
The trash bin is ____ the desk (debajo).
The printer is ____ to the computer (al lado).
The bank is ____ to the supermarket (al lado).
There is a fly ____ the wall (en la superficie de la pared).
questions.explanation: En superficies verticales también se usa 'on' (on the wall).

questions.question: The money is ____ my pocket (dentro del bolsillo).
The keys are ____ the drawer (dentro del cajón).
The cat is hiding ____ the sofa (debajo).
I found a coin ____ the chair (debajo).
The cafeteria is ____ to the elevator (al lado).
The clock is ____ the wall (en la pared).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe in, on, under o next (para 'next to').

questions.question: The file is ____ the floor (Sobre el suelo).
The picture is ____ the wall (En la pared).

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The pen is on the desk.
options: The pen is on the desk.
The pen is in the desk.
The pen is under the desk.
A pen is on the desk.
questions.correct_answer: The pen is on the desk.
